scope.evidence_basis: Author rereading and explicit calculation of the fixed-node argument, with source support scoped as recorded. Read the definition against original pp.2--3: only nonnegative scaling is required, the gauge is positive definite and degree one, and compact embedding refers to gauge-bounded sequences. No triangle inequality or difference closure is assumed. Trajectory measurability is handled in the principal rather than silently deduced from the gauge axioms.
